English.Char_Desc_450: Barbell Launcher is a free, portable Windows launcher. Press Alt+Space anywhere, type a few letters and press Enter. It finds Start menu and Microsoft Store apps by part of the name or by initials and puts the ones you use most first. It also copies calculations and dates (working days skip Korean public holidays), opens your own keyword shortcuts and pastes saved snippets. It saves nothing you type and does not connect to the internet by itself.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Barbell Launcher is a free Windows launcher. Press Alt+Space anywhere, type a few letters and press Enter. The first line is already selected.
It finds apps from the Start menu and the Microsoft Store by part of the name or by initials, such as vsc for Visual Studio Code, and puts the apps you start most at the top. Type a calculation and Enter copies the result; percentages work. Type today+30, a D-day like 12/31, or +10bd for working days that skip Korean public holidays. Give websites, shared folders and files a keyword, and add search addresses that take the words after the keyword. Snippets paste saved text where you were typing. Shortcuts can be shared with a team as one file; snippets stay out unless you choose them, and entries that start programs are unchecked when you import.
For Korean offices it also searches by initial consonants, understands text typed in the wrong input mode, and does VAT, 3.3% withholding, pyeong and amounts in Korean words.
It saves nothing you type in the search box and does not connect to the internet by itself. It does not type into windows that run as administrator; there the snippet is on the clipboard.
One exe file, no installation (about 9 MB), available in 11 languages. Free, no ads. No administrator rights needed.
